releases.title: Next-Gen TuneBar OS (Preview)
releases.changelog:
• FreeRTOS symmetric multiprocessing architecture.
• LittleFS asset filesystem with dynamic vector styling.
• Integrated multi-repo firmware updater with rollback guard.
• Low-latency ES8311 HiFi audio pipeline.
• Full 6-axis motion tracking and gesture controls.

releases.title: TuneBar v1.2.9: First-Boot Registration & Telemetry Fixes
releases.changelog:
• Enforced First-Boot Registration & Cloud Notice modal on screen.
• Immediate boot telemetry ping-home unblocked across Wi-Fi reconnects.
• Removed audio-player starvation of telemetry upload batches.
• Per-device table isolation (TB_<hash>) with dedicated telemetry.php dashboard.
• Full Web Remote Secrets Manager card for /secrets.ini editing and endpoint override.
• Server-side hardware authentication guard on AI Voice Assistant (ask.php).

releases.title: TuneBar v1.2.8 Firmware Release
releases.changelog:
• Automated multi-tenant telemetry and device registration guard.
• 4-Row 3-State IMU posture panel with active/inverted tracking.
• High-precision shelf inclinometer and uphill air bubble physics.
• Dynamic isometric chassis diagram in calibration wizard.
• Clock breathing interaction wake fix.

releases.title: TuneBar v1.2.7 Firmware Release
releases.changelog:
• Automated multi-tenant telemetry and device registration guard.
• 4-Row 3-State IMU posture panel with active/inverted tracking.
• High-precision shelf inclinometer and uphill air bubble physics.
• Dynamic isometric chassis diagram in calibration wizard.
• Clock breathing interaction wake fix.

releases.title: LVGL Vector Themes, Spirit Level & Memory Optimization
releases.changelog:
• Procedural LVGL vector styles replace 8 heavy bitmaps: binary dropped from 6.44MB to 4.04MB (2.21MB flash freed).
• 3-Panel Spirit Level App with 2D bullseye dial, live IMU telemetry, and 8-step guided calibration wizard.
• Calibration saves sensor bias and custom tolerance to NVS flash.
• Enlarged 46x38px Close button matching Settings on OTA and Spirit Level.
• 10-second breathing cycle (5s black, 1.5s fade in, 2s hold high, 1.5s fade out).
• Wi-Fi power down in clock mode saving ~50mA quiescent current.

releases.title: IMU Calibration & Backlight AP3032 Boost Fix
releases.changelog:
• Fixed AP3032 boost converter enable rail on EXIO1.
• Calibrated QMI8658 6-axis IMU orientation detection.
• Resolved 15-second screen timeout conflict on Nixie clock face.
• Improved touch responsiveness on 640x172 landscape display.

releases.title: Web Remote Controller & LAN Streaming
releases.changelog:
• Web Remote controller with virtual touch canvas and D-pad.
• Real-time IMU SSE live sensor streaming at 10Hz.
• LAN MP3 / FLAC file indexer and high-throughput streaming.
• Multi-catalog Internet Radio station directory.
• System telemetry and DRAM/PSRAM diagnostics API.

releases.title: Voice Assistant & Groq STT Engine
releases.changelog:
• ES7210 dual I2S microphone array driver integration.
• Groq Whisper audio pipeline with voice activity detection.
• Hardware acoustic echo cancellation calibration.
• Weather forecast voice responses with multi-day forecasts.

releases.title: Initial TuneBar Release
releases.changelog:
• Initial commercial firmware release for TuneBar ESP32-S3.
• LVGL 8.3 graphics engine on ST7701 640x172 display.
• Internet Radio player, Clock, Alarm, and Weather apps.
